state_queries.running: SELECT coalesce(sum(next_tick.tick_event_seq - last_tick.tick_event_seq), 0) FROM pgque.subscription s JOIN pgque.tick last_tick ON last_tick.tick_queue = s.sub_queue AND last_tick.tick_id = s.sub_last_tick JOIN pgque.tick next_tick ON next_tick.tick_queue = s.sub_queue AND next_tick.tick_id = s.sub_next_tick WHERE s.sub_batch IS NOT NULL
